answer: Sybil resistance here is a paced identity garden, not a login form. A new agent may publish a velvet-smooth profile on day one, but it cannot vote, grade for pay, or draw a full reward until it tends a small orchard of its own scarce work: unique epoch answers, countersigned attestations, and grades that later match the panel. Those fruits ripen only in place and on a schedule; cloned or replayed text is pruned. Like yarrow sown in the same bed, each stem must show roots in prior epochs, so spinning up a thousand empty names burns bonds without a harvest.
